articles.title: Police search for vehicle in fatal hit-and-run in Burlington
articles.summary: Police in Halton Region are searching for a vehicle after a woman was struck and killed in Burlington on Thursday. Investigators say the woman was in the area of Maple Avenue and Richmond Road when she was struck around 3:45 p.m. Police say the driver of the vehicle fled the scene northbound on Maple Avenue. […]

articles.title: Concerns raised over Metrolinx decision to close elevators at Danforth GO station for 3 months
articles.summary: Metrolinx staff say all elevators at Danforth GO station will be temporarily out of service as of Sept. 8 while upgrades are made.

articles.title: Anti-immigrant speaker blocked from entering Canada in time for Hamilton event
articles.summary: OTTAWA — Austrian anti-immigrant speaker Martin Sellner says he was not granted an electronic travel authorization in time for a trip to Hamilton to speak at a nationalist conference.

articles.title: Northbound lanes of Hwy. 427 closed after truck rollover
articles.summary: The northbound lanes of Highway 427 were closed for almost six hours after a truck hauling stones rolled over Thursday afternoon. Provincial police responded to the single-vehicle crash at Dixon Road around 1:45 p.m. No injuries have been reported. articles.summary: Poultry processing and packaging company Maple Lodge Farms has been fined $500,000 after a worker was injured at the plant in Brampton more than two years ago. articles.title: Judge upholds bail decision for 19-year-old man tied to U.S. Consulate shooting
articles.summary: An Ontario judge upheld a decision Thursday to grant bail to a 19-year-old man accused of shooting at the U.S. Consulate in downtown Toronto earlier this year.

articles.title: Police investigating suspected arson after cars at Liberal MP's home torched
articles.summary: Police are investigating a suspected arson at the home of a Scarborough MP after multiple cars were torched early Thursday, CBC News has learned.

articles.title: Mississauga clamping down on renovictions with new bylaw
articles.summary: Mississauga is clamping down on renovictions with a new bylaw taking effect on Sept. 1 aimed at landlords attempting to raise rents under the guise of renovations.

articles.title: Advance voting underway for provincial byelections in 2 GTA ridings
articles.summary: Advance voting is underway this week in provincial byelections in Scarborough Southwest and York-Simcoe.

articles.title: Ontario expanding Oshawa GO station with 2 new tracks
articles.summary: Construction is underway at the Durham College Oshawa GO station to add two new tracks, the Ontario government announced on Wednesday.
